test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given graph shows the production of food grains of a country in different years. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5be7d4a739ca42ebfcc605df6f4bf47f1518c53ad605456bdd2a418c54c204ee.png] 

The percentage increase in production from 2010 to 2011 was (Rounded off to 2 decimal places):
solution:
**Given:**

Production in 2010 = 67 million tonnes

Production in 2011 = 72 million tonnes

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = [(New Value - Original Value) / Original Value] × 100

**Calculation:**

Increase in production = 72 - 67

⇒ Increase = 5 million tonnes

Percentage increase = (5 / 67) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase = 7.46%

**∴ The percentage increase in production from 2010 to 2011 was 7.46%.**
